entries.title: Update 2.61.0.26
entries.description: Bf 109 F-4 — a bug that caused some of the cockpit elements to shift or disappear, some instruments to stop working and the glazing to change color has been fixed.

entries.title: Update 2.61.0.24
entries.description: A bug that made it impossible to be matched into an “Assault. Ground Arcade” battle when having a 13.7 vehicle lineup has been fixed.

entries.title: Update 2.61.0.20
entries.description: Z-10ME, Ka-52, A-10C, AH-1W (all variants) — the minimum closing speed for a threat to be detected by the MAWS has been reduced from 200 m/s to 80 m/s.

entries.title: Update 2.61.0.17
entries.description: A bug that sometimes caused the game startup after logging in to take much more time than usual has been fixed.

entries.title: War Thunder "Eagle's Shadow" - Changelog
entries.description: Eagle’s Shadow introduces a comprehensive selection of vehicles, ranging from the modern Leopard 2A8 equipped with the Trophy APS and the Second World War Fulmar Mk.II with 8,000 rounds of ammunition, to the F-15EX featuring excellent armament options and the Su-15TM equipped with the newly added R-98 missiles.
